# Document signing: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Signed documents must be stored with a timestamp from a trusted authority under the e-Signature Standard. |
| C2 | Signers must be shown the full text before signing, per the Disclosure Rules. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a signer, I want to read the whole document before I can press sign so that I know what I am agreeing to.
US-2 As a sender, I want to download the signed document so that I can file it.
US-3 As a signer, I want to sign a document on my phone so that I do not need a printer.
US-4 As a sender, I want to see who has signed a document so that I can chase the rest.
constraints: Signed documents must be stored with a timestamp from a trusted authority under the e-Signature Standard.
Signers must be shown the full text before signing, per the Disclosure Rules.
